newsitem.title: POLAND: Warta sets issue price at PLN 48.
newsitem.headline: Warta sets issue price at PLN 48.

text.p: Polish insurance company TUiR Warta SA set the issue price of its share issue share issue at 48 zlotys, a company spokesman said.
It will issue between 865,380 to 2,596,139 shares.
"The issue price was set at 48 zlotys per share," Jacek Likowski told Reuters.
He said the subscription period would be set by the supervisory board on December 20.
He earlier said the new issue was aimed at setting up a financial capital group encompassing banks and Warta.

The Warta issue is directed to Bank Przemyslowo Handlowy SA (BPH), Kredyt Bank SA, the state-owned Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) which is slated for privatisation in April 1997, and two minority shareholders.
Likowski did not say how the shares would be alloted.
